instruction: Show me how to adjust VLC so its volume limit is 200.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's maximum volume setting to 200. The evaluator uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric which reads the VLC config file and checks if qt-max-volume=200. Default value is 125, so the user must navigate to audio settings and change it.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from OS-specific paths
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses config file and checks qt-max-volume setting
Parameter handling is correct: function uses 'rule' parameter and directly accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume']
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the exact setting mentioned in instruction
Edge cases handled: type conversion (int to string), FileNotFoundError, general exceptions
Default value logic correct: uses '125' as default when setting not found in config
State accessibility good: VLC config file is persistent, no postconfig needed
